daas-irab:1-5.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿فَتَحْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَتْحاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مُبِيناً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لِيَغْفِرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after the lām. ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to fataḥnā. ﴿تَقَدَّمَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما تَأَخَّرَ﴾ conjoined to mā taqaddama. ﴿وَيُتِمَّ﴾ conjoined to yaghfira. ﴿نِعْمَتَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَيَهْدِيَكَ﴾ conjoined to yaghfira; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿صِراطاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُسْتَقِيماً﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَيَنْصُرَكَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿نَصْراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿عَزِيزاً﴾ an adjective. ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ﴾ a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيَزْدادُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit an after the lām of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿إِيماناً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām of causation, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to anzala. ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿إِيمانِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿جُنُودُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to al-samāwāt; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿عَلِيماً حَكِيماً﴾ two khabars of kāna; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لِيُدْخِلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit an after the lām of causation, with its fāʿil latent; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām of causation, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted, its implied form being "He commanded jihad in order to admit" (amara bi-l-jihād li-yudkhila). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾ conjoined to al-muʾminīn. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of jannāt. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to khālidīn. ﴿وَيُكَفِّرَ﴾ a conjunction, and conjoined to yudkhila. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سَيِّئاتِهِمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ the wāw of circumstance, and a defective past verb. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ its noun. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَوْزاً﴾ the khabar of kāna. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ an adjective; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:6-9.t: ﴿وَيُعَذِّبَ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْمُنافِقِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْمُنافِقاتِ﴾ conjoined to al-munāfiqīn. ﴿وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكاتِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الظَّانِّينَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) al-ẓānnīn. ﴿ظَنَّ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿السَّوْءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿دائِرَةُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿السَّوْءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَلَعَنَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَساءَتْ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a past verb of blame (dhamm) whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَصِيراً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a fronted khabar. ﴿جُنُودُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to al-samāwāt; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزاً حَكِيماً﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and kāna, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿شاهِداً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿وَمُبَشِّراً وَنَذِيراً﴾ conjoined to shāhidan. ﴿لِتُؤْمِنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to arsalnāka. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to tuʾminū. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ﴾ conjoined to tuʾminū. ﴿بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا﴾ two adverbs of time (ẓarfā zamān).

daas-irab:10-11.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿يُبايِعُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّما﴾ a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يُبايِعُونَ اللَّهَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿يَدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a fatḥa (اللَّهَ); as muḍāf ilayhi it is اللَّهِ.] ﴿فَوْقَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause is a second khabar of inna. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿نَكَثَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis of the condition, and innamā is a restraining particle and the restrained one. ﴿يَنْكُثُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of man. ﴿عَلى نَفْسِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a conjunction, and a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْفى﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿عاهَدَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis, the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb and its first object. ﴿أَجْراً﴾ its second object. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of man. ﴿سَيَقُولُ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْمُخَلَّفُونَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْأَعْرابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to al-mukhallafūn. ﴿شَغَلَتْنا أَمْوالُنا﴾ a past verb and its object, and amwālunā is its fāʿil. ﴿وَأَهْلُونا﴾ conjoined to amwālunā; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَاسْتَغْفِرْ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of laysa; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition), and an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَمْلِكُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, the nominal clause is the object of the saying, and the clause qul is resumptive. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to yamliku. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to yamliku. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿أَرادَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿ضَرًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَرادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعاً﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿بِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to khabīran. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿خَبِيراً﴾ the khabar of kāna; the clause kāna is resumptive.

daas-irab:12-14.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī). ﴿ظَنَنْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy anna; its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), omitted. ﴿لَنْ يَنْقَلِبَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan. ﴿الرَّسُولُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ conjoined to al-rasūl; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of an. ﴿إِلى أَهْلِيهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَبَداً﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of ẓanantum, and the clause ẓanantum is resumptive. ﴿وَزُيِّنَ ذلِكَ﴾ a conjunction, and a passive past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَظَنَنْتُمْ﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ظَنَّ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿السَّوْءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ its khabar. ﴿بُوراً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَمْ يُؤْمِنْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, with its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَإِنَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of causation (taʿlīl), and inna and its noun. ﴿أَعْتَدْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سَعِيراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar of inna, the nominal clause is a causal explanation, and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of man. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿مُلْكُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to al-samāwāt. ﴿يَغْفِرُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent, the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause yaghfiru is resumptive. ﴿وَيُعَذِّبُ﴾ conjoined to yaghfiru, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and kāna, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿سَيَقُولُ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ﴾ the sīn is a particle of the future, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذَا﴾ an adverbial conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿انْطَلَقْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِلى مَغانِمَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿لِتَأْخُذُوها﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the wāw is its fāʿil and hā its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to inṭalaqtum. ﴿ذَرُونا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and nā its object. ﴿نَتَّبِعْكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause dharūnā is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿كَلامَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is the object of yurīdūna. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَنْ تَتَّبِعُونا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by lan; the wāw is its fāʿil and nā its object; the clause is the object of the saying, and the clause qul is resumptive. ﴿كَذلِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿قالَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَسَيَقُولُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, the sīn is a particle of the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) or conjunction. ﴿تَحْسُدُونَنا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and nā its object; the clause is conjoined to sa-yaqūlūna. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَفْقَهُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kānū, and the clause kānū is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِلْمُخَلَّفِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنَ الْأَعْرابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to al-mukhallafīn; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَتُدْعَوْنَ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلى قَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to tudʿawna. ﴿أُولِي﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of qawm, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿بَأْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَدِيدٍ﴾ an adjective of baʾs. ﴿تُقاتِلُونَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يُسْلِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and in is a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿تُطِيعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿يُؤْتِكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive in that it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ its fāʿil. ﴿أَجْراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَسَناً﴾ an adjective; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and in is a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿تَتَوَلَّوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a particle of comparison and of the genitive, and mā is maṣdariyya (yielding a verbal noun). ﴿تَوَلَّيْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from mā and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to tawallaytum. ﴿يُعَذِّبْكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿أَلِيماً﴾ an adjective; the clause is the apodosis of a jussive-causing condition, not joined to the fāʾ, and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:17-18.t: ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عَلَى الْأَعْمى﴾ the fronted khabar (predicate) of laysa. ﴿حَرَجٌ﴾ its postponed noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and man is a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُطِعِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ conjoined to the Name of Majesty. ﴿يُدْخِلْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of man, and the clause yudkhilhu is the apodosis with no grammatical position, because it is not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of jannāt, and the nominal clause man… is resumptive. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿مَنْ يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذاباً أَلِيماً﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿رَضِيَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the answer to the oath. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿يُبايِعُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿تَحْتَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿الشَّجَرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَعَلِمَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [element that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَأَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَأَثابَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its first object, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿فَتْحاً﴾ its second object. ﴿قَرِيباً﴾ an adjective; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:19-21.t: ﴿وَمَغانِمَ﴾ a conjunction, and conjoined to fatḥan. ﴿كَثِيرَةً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿يَأْخُذُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and hā its object; the clause is an adjective of maghānim. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزاً حَكِيماً﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and kāna, its noun and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَعَدَكُمُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a postponed fāʿil. ﴿مَغانِمَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَثِيرَةً﴾ an adjective; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَأْخُذُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause is an adjective of maghānim. ﴿فَعَجَّلَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَكَفَّ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَيْدِيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلِتَكُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), its noun being latent. ﴿آيَةً﴾ its khabar. ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to kaffa. ﴿وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿صِراطاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُسْتَقِيماً﴾ an adjective; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأُخْرى﴾ a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is an adjective of ukhrā. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿أَحاطَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and kāna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to qadīran. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِيراً﴾ the khabar of kāna; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:22-24.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and law is a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿قاتَلَكُمُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَوَلَّوُا﴾ the lām falls in the apodosis of the condition, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿الْأَدْبارَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَجِدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿وَلِيًّا﴾ its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿نَصِيراً﴾ conjoined to waliyyan. ﴿سُنَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّتِي﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of sunna. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿خَلَتْ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَلَنْ تَجِدَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿لِسُنَّةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to tabdīlan. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَبْدِيلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَّ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَيْدِيَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِبَطْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَكَّةَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to kaffa. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle causing the accusative. ﴿أَظْفَرَكُمْ﴾ a past verb in the position of the accusative; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and kāna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun. ﴿بِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to baṣīran. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بَصِيراً﴾ the khabar of kāna; the clause is the ṣila, and the clause kāna is resumptive.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿هُمُ الَّذِينَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَصَدُّوكُمْ﴾ conjoined to kafarū. ﴿عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of al-masjid. ﴿وَالْهَدْيَ﴾ mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), and the wāw is for accompaniment (maʿiyya). ﴿مَعْكُوفاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنْ يَبْلُغَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, with its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿مَحِلَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and lawlā is a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿رِجالٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted. ﴿مُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَنِساءٌ مُؤْمِناتٌ﴾ conjoined to rijālun muʾminūn. ﴿لَمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْ تَطَؤُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is a badal (substitute) of the hāʾ in taʿlamūhum. ﴿فَتُصِيبَكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes it, and the kāf is its object. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مَعَرَّةٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the object of tuṣībakum. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيُدْخِلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿فِي رَحْمَتِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar from an and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted and implied. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿تَزَيَّلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَعَذَّبْنَا﴾ the lām falls in the apodosis of the condition, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of law and has no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source reads «جواب لولا محل لها», evidently «جواب لو لا محل لها» run together.] ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أَلِيماً﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:26-27.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) jaʿala. ﴿الْحَمِيَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿حَمِيَّةَ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿الْجاهِلِيَّةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَأَنْزَلَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿سَكِينَتَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلى رَسُولِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its first object, with its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿كَلِمَةَ﴾ its second object. ﴿التَّقْوى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَكانُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun. ﴿أَحَقَّ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿بِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to aḥaqqa. ﴿وَأَهْلَها﴾ conjoined to aḥaqqa. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and kāna and its noun. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ʿalīman. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيماً﴾ the khabar of kāna; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām falls in the answer to an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿صَدَقَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿رَسُولَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الرُّؤْيا﴾ accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ṣadaqa; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَتَدْخُلُنَّ﴾ the lām of the answer to the omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the nūn that is dropped because of the succession of like letters; the dropped wāw is its fāʿil, and the nūn is for emphasis; the clause is the answer to an omitted oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿الْمَسْجِدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَرامَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿شاءَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil; the verbal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the context indicates it. ﴿آمِنِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مُحَلِّقِينَ﴾ a second ḥāl. ﴿رُؤُسَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَمُقَصِّرِينَ﴾ conjoined to muḥalliqīn. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَخافُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿فَعَلِمَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ its object; the clause is conjoined to ṣadaqa. ﴿لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَجَعَلَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَتْحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَرِيباً﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:28-29.t: ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرْسَلَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿رَسُولَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِالْهُدى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَدِينِ﴾ conjoined to al-hudā. ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيُظْهِرَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَى الدِّينِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿كُلِّهِ﴾ a tawkīd (emphasis) of al-dīn; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to arsala. ﴿وَكَفى﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, the fāʿil of kafā. ﴿شَهِيداً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿أَشِدَّاءُ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ashiddāʾ. ﴿رُحَماءُ﴾ a second khabar. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to ruḥamāʾ. ﴿تَراهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿رُكَّعاً سُجَّداً﴾ two ḥāls. ﴿يَبْتَغُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَضْلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to faḍlan. ﴿وَرِضْواناً﴾ conjoined to faḍlan. ﴿سِيماهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿مِنْ أَثَرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿السُّجُودِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿فِي التَّوْراةِ﴾ ḥāl; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَمَثَلُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي الْإِنْجِيلِ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿كَزَرْعٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of zarʿ. ﴿فَآزَرَهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined to akhraja. ﴿فَاسْتَغْلَظَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَاسْتَوى﴾ also conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلى سُوقِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to istawā. ﴿يُعْجِبُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الزُّرَّاعَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِيَغِيظَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by the implicit an after the lām of causation, with its fāʿil latent. ﴿بِهِمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْكُفَّارِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (الْكُفَّارِ); as mafʿūl bihi it is الْكُفَّارَ.] The interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to waʿada. ﴿وَعَدَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, and the clause waʿada is resumptive. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ conjoined to āmanū. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مَغْفِرَةً﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of waʿada. ﴿وَأَجْراً﴾ conjoined to maghfira. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ an adjective.
